datasets.name: team_season
queryLines:
SELECT
  season, team, games, wins, losses, ties,
  CONCAT(wins, '-', losses, IF(ties > 0, CONCAT('-', ties), '')) AS record,
  CONCAT(ats_covers, '-', ats_losses) AS ats_record,
  ROUND(off_epa_per_play, 3)  AS offense_epa,
  ROUND(-def_epa_per_play, 3) AS defense_epa,   -- sign flipped: higher = better defense
  ROUND(net_epa_per_play, 3)  AS net_epa,
  net_epa_rank,
  record_rank,
  luck_gap
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_season
ORDER BY season DESC, luck_gap

datasets.name: qb_leaders
queryLines:
SELECT season, epa_rank, player_name, latest_team, dropbacks,
       ROUND(epa_per_dropback, 3) AS epa_per_dropback, ROUND(cpoe, 1) AS cpoe
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_qb_season
WHERE epa_rank <= 15

datasets.name: team_games
queryLines:
SELECT season, week, game_date, team, opponent, home_away, outcome,
       CONCAT(points_for, '-', points_against) AS score,
       ROUND(net_epa_per_play, 3) AS net_epa, cover_margin, ats_outcome
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_games
WHERE game_type = 'REG'

datasets.name: qb_target_concentration
queryLines:
WITH primary_qb AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    latest_team AS team,
    player_name AS qb_name,
    pass_attempts
  FROM
    workspace.nfl.gold_player_season
  WHERE
    position = 'QB'
    AND pass_attempts > 0
    AND season BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, latest_team ORDER BY pass_attempts DESC, player_name)
      = 1
),
lead_receiver AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    latest_team AS team,
    player_name AS receiver_name,
    targets
  FROM
    workspace.nfl.gold_player_season
  WHERE
    targets > 0
    AND season BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, latest_team ORDER BY targets DESC, player_name) = 1
)
SELECT
  q.season,
  q.team,
  q.qb_name,
  q.pass_attempts AS qb_pass_attempts,
  r.receiver_name,
  r.targets AS receiver_targets,
  ROUND(100.0 * r.targets / NULLIF(q.pass_attempts, 0), 1) AS concentration_pct
FROM
  primary_qb q
    JOIN lead_receiver r
      ON r.season = q.season
      AND r.team = q.team
ORDER BY
  q.season DESC,
  concentration_pct DESC

datasets.name: passing_leaders
queryLines:
SELECT p.season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.season ORDER BY p.passing_yards DESC) AS rk,
       p.headshot_url, p.player_name, t.team_logo_url, p.latest_team AS team,
       p.games, p.completions, p.pass_attempts, p.passing_yards, p.passing_tds, p.interceptions,
       ROUND(q.epa_per_dropback, 3) AS epa_per_dropback
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_season p
LEFT JOIN workspace.nfl.silver_teams t ON t.team = p.latest_team
LEFT JOIN workspace.nfl.gold_qb_season q ON q.season = p.season AND q.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE p.position = 'QB' AND p.pass_attempts > 0
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.season ORDER BY p.passing_yards DESC) <= 15
ORDER BY p.season DESC, rk

datasets.name: rushing_leaders
queryLines:
SELECT p.season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.season ORDER BY p.rushing_yards DESC) AS rk,
       p.headshot_url, p.player_name, p.position, t.team_logo_url, p.latest_team AS team,
       p.games, p.carries, p.rushing_yards, ROUND(p.rushing_yards / NULLIF(p.carries, 0), 1) AS yards_per_carry,
       p.rushing_tds, ROUND(p.rushing_epa, 1) AS rushing_epa
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_season p
LEFT JOIN workspace.nfl.silver_teams t ON t.team = p.latest_team
WHERE p.carries > 0
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.season ORDER BY p.rushing_yards DESC) <= 15
ORDER BY p.season DESC, rk

datasets.name: receiving_leaders
queryLines:
SELECT p.season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.season ORDER BY p.receiving_yards DESC) AS rk,
       p.headshot_url, p.player_name, p.position, t.team_logo_url, p.latest_team AS team,
       p.games, p.targets, p.receptions, p.receiving_yards, p.receiving_tds, ROUND(p.receiving_epa, 1) AS receiving_epa
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_player_season p
LEFT JOIN workspace.nfl.silver_teams t ON t.team = p.latest_team
WHERE p.targets > 0
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.season ORDER BY p.receiving_yards DESC) <= 15
ORDER BY p.season DESC, rk

datasets.name: team_betting
queryLines:
SELECT b.season, s.team_logo_url, b.team, s.team_name,
       CONCAT(s.wins, '-', s.losses, IF(s.ties > 0, CONCAT('-', s.ties), '')) AS record,
       CONCAT(b.ats_covers, '-', b.ats_losses, IF(b.ats_pushes > 0, CONCAT('-', b.ats_pushes), '')) AS ats_record,
       ROUND(100 * b.ats_cover_pct, 1) AS ats_cover_pct,
       CONCAT(b.favorite_covers, '-', b.favorite_ats_losses) AS ats_as_favorite,
       CONCAT(b.underdog_covers, '-', b.underdog_ats_losses) AS ats_as_underdog,
       b.outright_underdog_wins,
       CONCAT(b.overs, '-', b.unders, IF(b.ou_pushes > 0, CONCAT('-', b.ou_pushes), '')) AS over_under,
       ROUND(100 * b.over_pct, 1) AS over_pct,
       ROUND(b.avg_cover_margin, 1) AS avg_cover_margin,
       ROUND(b.avg_total_vs_line, 1) AS avg_total_vs_line
FROM workspace.nfl.gold_team_betting b
JOIN workspace.nfl.gold_team_season s ON s.season = b.season AND s.team = b.team
ORDER BY b.season DESC, b.ats_cover_pct DESC

lines: Every play since 1999, refreshed each Tuesday. **EPA** = expected points added per play (nflverse model). Offense: higher is better. Defense is sign-flipped so higher is also better. **Luck gap** = net-EPA rank minus record rank: positive means the record flatters the team, negative means it is playing better than its record.
